phy-session-audit 1.0.0 — initial release

- First release of a session and cookie security auditor per OWASP A07:2021 (Identification and Authentication Failures).
- Scans source code in Express, Koa, Fastify, Flask, Django, FastAPI, Go net/http, Spring Boot, and Rails for 10 common session misconfigurations and implementation flaws.
- Detects missing cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), session tokens in URLs, missing session regeneration after login, lack of CSRF protection, client-side session storage, missing timeouts, weak session ID generation, and broad cookie domain scope.
- Provides CI fail-gate, severity filtering, and clear mitigation guidance with zero external dependencies.
- Includes sample output and quick-start instructions.
